metric.definition: For list H, omit only zero rows when forming highest homogeneous input parts. dreg(H) is the first zero degree of the graded quotient by their ideal, assuming finite dimension.
metric.boundaries: Zero quotient dreg0; empty list in no variables dreg1. Ordinary ideals, input highest-part ideals and solving degree are distinct.

primary_reference.role: Definitions only. Exact URL is in handoff.inputs and external_read_scope, carried explicitly into dispatch; repository read_scope contains paths only. Retrieve before preliminary algebra.

quantifiers: For every prime p>3 and alpha,beta in F_p with nonsingular y^2=X^3+alpha X+beta, every rational finite target (a,b), every valid original public interval t,s with 2^s<p, and every one of the three declared rationality arms, consider finite k=2 and constant B stratum.
All polynomial coefficients, affine constants and row-combination scalars lie in F_p. Work in full polynomial rings, adjoining v^p-v for EVERY declared variable, including auxiliaries.
The strict claim additionally assumes b!=0 and the original highest-part quotient nonzero; no ordinary solution-existence premise or witness-driven row/stratum selection is assumed.
Rows and normalization below are prospective source-binding assertions to be checked, not trusted independent facts. The mathematical target must be refused or narrowed if source binding fails.

systems.variables: A0, q=chart.A1, z=(support.u0=u0, support.u1=u1, stratum.inverse, every interval coefficient/quotient/remainder and every rationality auxiliary). Fixed B0=1 and B1=0 are constants.
systems.normalization: A=A0+qX, B=1, U=X^2+u1 X+u0; pole degree3, c=-1.
systems.full_F: All literal canonical_chart rows in original X coordinates plus all variable field rows. Keep all norm/sign and every other row; identically zero source rows impose nothing.
systems.auxiliary_rows_H: All actual non-norm/sign rows plus z field equations; EXCLUDE A0 and q field equations from H. Reviewer must establish that every H row depends only on z in the constant stratum across all three arms.
systems.K_and_C: If that source separation holds, K is the ideal generated by the nonzero highest parts of H in F_p[z], and C=F_p[z]/K. K refers only to this ideal, not to the ground field.
systems.raw_G: Substitute A0=b-aq into literal F, retaining every nonzero row; omit the transformed A0 field row only with both ordinary and highest-part certificates. No row recombination.
systems.added_F_plus: Append ONE row R=N1+2aN2 to F, without deleting or replacing any original row.
systems.candidate_G_plus: Substitute A0=b-aq into F_plus and retain all nonzero substituted rows, including R. The same certified field-row exception applies.
systems.v: u0+a u1, a homogeneous degree-one element of F_p[z], possibly zero or a zero divisor in C.
systems.projection: Original (chart.A0,chart.A1) becomes (chart.A1) only. The runtime system keeps q projected, U lifted, and every auxiliary. A graded quotient calculation removing q does not authorize runtime elimination of q.

claims_to_challenge.C1_source: All non-norm/sign/non-coefficient-field rows are independent of BOTH A0 and q in constant stratum for all three source arms; exact imported binding loop must substantiate this.
claims_to_challenge.C2_original: I=(A0+a q,q^2,K); Rpoly/I is graded-isomorphic to C[q]/(q^2), with no additional assumptions on the internal relations of C.
claims_to_challenge.C3_raw: When a!=0, raw_G has a highest-part quotient graded-isomorphic to the original one, so regularity is equal for b=0 and b!=0; both impossible B strata also give equality at0. a=0 requires separate treatment.
claims_to_challenge.C4_addition: Appending R changes neither the original ordinary ideal nor original highest-part ideal. Its proposed highest part is 2q(A0+a q); verify it, including a=0.
claims_to_challenge.C5_reduced: For every a and b!=0, the exact G_plus top ideal is (q^2,K,v+2bq), so the graded quotient is C/(v^2). Derive both inclusions and mutually inverse graded maps. This is a quotient calculation, not a second system pivot.
claims_to_challenge.C6_strict: For nonzero finite C, if d is its greatest nonzero graded degree, dreg(F)=d+2 and dreg(G_plus)<=d+1, a strict decrease of at least1. Neither d nor complete-chart values2p/p+1 are prescribed.
claims_to_challenge.C7_b_zero: For b=0, proposed quotient is (C/(v))[q]/(q^2); no uniform strict decrease is claimed. Determine exact condition for equality/strictness using top-degree survival, and cover C=0.
claims_to_challenge.C8_fidelity: Appending R and eliminating only A0 preserve full solutions by reconstruction (A0,q,z)=(b-aq,q,z) over extensions. Preserve corresponding complete projected sets/fibers and signed-recovery inputs analytically; authenticated bit-model equivalence and cost results remain unproved.

premise_controls: C=0 gives both unit quotients and dreg0; no strictness below0. Nonzero finite C is an explicit strictness premise.
b=0 with v=0 in a nonzero finite graded C retains C[q]/q^2; supply a concrete graded-ring equality control, labeled an algebraic control rather than a realized chart.
b=0 with a quotient C/(v) that kills the highest surviving component provides a contrasting strict control; do not claim it is an actual chart without source evidence.
a!=0 raw substitution versus appended R distinguishes row-list representation from merely reducing variable count.
a=0 makes R duplicate N1; prove its outcome independently instead of applying the a!=0 raw-equality argument.
Omitting surviving field rows, coefficients outside F_p, ordinary-redundant row deletion, and Boolean x=y+z without transformed idempotence must show the missing premises.
Constant B=1 makes zero/linear strata literal unit-ideal cases; identity targets, k0, identity k1 and k!=2 have no theorem under this construction.
A generic arbitrary H involving q or A0 invalidates the source-separation premise; explicitly show why a source-aware check is load-bearing.
Adding auxiliary rows may change C and its Hilbert degrees; no diagnostic2p or p+1 threshold may be carried over. No semiregularity or solving-degree equality assumption.

joints.name: source_separation
joints.attack: Derive actual finite-k2 normalization and norm/sign rows from source. Challenge the assertion that every other constant-stratum row is independent of both A0 and q in all three arms; include imported binding variables and every inverse/interval/rationality auxiliary. A hidden coefficient dependency breaks the claimed C factorization.

joints.name: original_quotient
joints.attack: Determine the full original highest-part ideal by both inclusions, with all field equations. Establish or refute the proposed C[q]/(q^2) quotient. Handle unit and nonzero finite C without assuming that the ordinary system is solvable.

joints.name: raw_equality
joints.attack: For literal original-X rows and a!=0, compare both highest ideals after only A0 substitution; distinguish polynomial-variable translation from recombination of coefficient rows. Challenge a=0 and both ordinate cases.

joints.name: added_row
joints.attack: Check R=N1+2aN2 as a polynomial identity before substitution, and separately check whether its top part belongs to the ORIGINAL top ideal. Show whether both ideals are unchanged; a=0 duplicates must be treated. Do not delete or replace any old nonzero row.

joints.name: reduced_quotient
joints.attack: For added-row then A0 substitution, derive the exact reduced highest ideal and both quotient-map directions for b!=0. Treat a=0 and a!=0 independently and include every transformed field row. q elimination is only a graded-ring calculation.

joints.name: strictness_boundaries
joints.attack: Independently establish the proposed dreg drop from exact graded support; cover b=0, C=0, a=0, impossible strata and special/identity charts. Construct equality and omitted-premise controls; no exact diagnostic threshold is inherited.

joints.name: solutions_projection
joints.attack: Prove ordinary-system solution reconstruction and corresponding auxiliary-fiber equality over extensions. Original projection is (A0,q), reduced projection is (q); q remains a system input. Map normalized A,B,U and signed output with both beta signs; state compiled-model and cost obligations.

joints.name: claim_boundary
joints.attack: Separate accepted one-pivot non-increase, literal raw-row equality, added-row strictness, diagnostic values, solving degree, compiler correctness and certified pruning. Give per-joint holds/breaks/inconclusive with exact proof or counterexample; no outcome is prewritten.
